purpose: Make OBS an internal event-driven execution invariant over every material Brain and external-world dependency used by consequential work.
rules: Every consequential work unit carries a PROJECT_BRAIN_CONTINUOUS_OBS_CONTEXT_V1 context.
Every material dependency that can change the decision is declared, including external-world state.
Volatile dependencies carry direct evidence, observation time, scope, and a bounded freshness lease.
Missing, stale, contradictory, failed, or unverified material dependency state becomes UNKNOWN and blocks execution.
Canonical pointer, active goal hierarchy, and real-output scoreboard are content-hash bound in every work context.
Every execution or verification receipt triggers revalidation before the next material step.
Only affected layers are revalidated when locality is provable; otherwise the whole context is invalidated.
OBS has zero progress credit and may not delay a valid proof-producing action that survives revalidation.
